content:
I want to floor a Float and have the result be a Nat. I know that with Batteries, I can do float.toRat0.toNat, but adding batteries to my codebase significantly increases compile and file refresh times - without Batteries, compilation takes about 1 second, and with Batteries it takes closer to 10 seconds sometimes. I can't justify that just for one function.

Is there any way builtin for this?
So it looks like f.toUInt64.toNat exists, I had previously tried f.toInt64.toNat which does not exist.
